def process(clean_identity_theft_data, load_new_england_states) -> pd.DataFrame:
    ne_states = load_new_england_states['Name'].tolist()
    ne_state_abbreviations = {
        'Connecticut': 'CT',
        'Maine': 'ME',
        'Massachusetts': 'MA',
        'New Hampshire': 'NH',
        'Rhode Island': 'RI',
        'Vermont': 'VT'
    }
    ne_abbrevs = [ne_state_abbreviations[state] for state in ne_states]
    
    # Filter to only New England metropolitan areas by checking if state abbreviation appears in the metropolitan area name
    filtered = clean_identity_theft_data[
        clean_identity_theft_data['Metropolitan_Area'].str.contains('|'.join(ne_abbrevs), case=False, na=False)
    ].copy()
    
    return filtered
